'''Shamel''' was a [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Smuggler/Legends|smuggler]] running a small criminal organization during the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]].

==Biography==
A [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Smuggler/Legends|smuggler]], Shamel made a living running a localized smuggling ring during the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]]. During the organization's history, Shamel employed a young orphan boy named [[Tesslar]] who stole [[Speeder/Legends|speeders]] from the gang.<ref name="GG10" />
